seo.title: One Character Shipped This Bug #golang #codereview
altTitles: Google Approved This Bug. One Colon Caused It. #golang
The One-Character Bug That Got Past Google #programming
seo.hook: A single colon turned a caught error into a silent success in Google's gRPC library. It was reviewed, approved, merged, and fixed a week later. Alibaba's free open-source reviewer found it blind.
seo.description: A variable-scope bug in grpc/grpc-go: err := inside an if creates a new variable, so the check two lines later reads the function's own nil return value and reports success. Found blind by Open Code Review.
seo.breakdown: the colon, the box that disappears, and the tool that caught it
seo.pinned: One character. Which one would you have spotted?
sources: github.com/grpc/grpc-go/pull/7461 — the pull request that shipped the bug

data.headline: One character shipped a bug
data.subtext: and a free tool found it blind

scenes.narration: A variable is just a labelled box. This one's called err — short for error. Now look at that colon before the equals sign. It makes a brand new box, right there.

lines.detail: the colon makes a NEW box
lines.sub: a second err, born right here
lines.label: new box

lines.sub: and the new box ends with it

scenes.narration: The real error drops into that new box. Then the brackets close — and a box made inside brackets dies with them. It's gone, and everything in it goes too.

steps.title: outer
steps.label: old box
steps.sub: the function already has an err

steps.title: fence
steps.label: inside
steps.sub: now we are inside the brackets

steps.title: fill
steps.label: filled
steps.sub: the real error goes in here

steps.title: vanish
steps.label: gone
steps.sub: the brackets close, and it is swept away

scenes.narration: Two lines later the code asks for err. It reads the only box left, the old one. Empty. So a failed call reports success.

steps.title: ask
steps.label: err?
steps.sub: the code asks for err again

steps.title: verdict
steps.label: empty
steps.sub: it finds nothing, so it says all is well

scenes.narration: Alibaba's free reviewer found both, blind, in two minutes — then fixed them the same way the maintainers did.
